fragments.contract: Server1 Ollama runs on 127.0.0.1:11434 and exposes llama3.2:3b, qwen2.5-coder:1.5b, and nomic-embed-text for the local-AI/OpenWebUI demo.
do_not_regress: Keep OpenWebUI on host networking when Ollama binds to Server1 loopback.
Validate /api/tags after model pulls and record model digests.
Treat large model additions as explicit choices because Server1 is CPU-only until a newer GPU is installed.

fragments.contract: Run bkc-openwebui with Podman host networking, PORT=8080, WEBUI_URL/CORS_ALLOW_ORIGIN set to the edge URL, and OLLAMA_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:11434.
